entries.label: Radar range
entries.description: World-unit radius the minimap covers. Lower zooms in; higher shows more of the arena. Applies live.

entries.label: Show players
entries.description: Show every player and bot on the minimap. Allies beyond radar range pin to the rim.

entries.label: Show enemies
entries.description: Show living enemies within radar range.

entries.label: Show orbs (health / mana)
entries.description: Show dropped health and mana orbs within radar range.

entries.label: Show items
entries.description: Show dropped item sacks, bonuses, and modded item drops within radar range.

entries.label: Show gold
entries.description: Show dropped gold within radar range.

entries.label: Show Solomon Dig
entries.description: Mark the Solomon Dig site whenever the dig actor is live; the mark pulses while a dig is in progress.
